picks.headline: Google announces Gemma 4 optimized for the Pixel 10's TPU
picks.excerpt: Google unveiled Gemma 4, a new open model tuned to run on the Pixel 10's Tensor G5 TPU, pushing more capable generative AI fully on-device for phones.
picks.rationale: New open on-device model (Gemma 4) tuned to the Pixel 10 TPU - a novel release that raises the ceiling on what generative AI can run locally on a phone.

picks.headline: Gemini Nano 4 is finally here with Samsung's latest foldables
picks.excerpt: Google's newest on-device model, Gemini Nano 4, arrives first on the Galaxy Z Fold 8 and Flip 8, adding support for 140+ languages and stronger multimodal understanding running locally on the phone.
picks.rationale: The actual on-device model release (Nano 4, 140+ languages, stronger multimodal) powering Galaxy foldables - chosen over the same-launch subjective hands-on.

picks.headline: Samsung's new Gemini-powered Intelligent Eyewear, hands-on
picks.excerpt: A hands-on with Samsung's first Gemini-powered Intelligent Eyewear, built with Warby Parker and Gentle Monster - lightweight Android XR glasses offering hands-free translation, note-taking and navigation.
picks.rationale: First real hands-on with Samsung's fashion-partner Gemini AI eyewear (Warby Parker/Gentle Monster) - a distinct product from the earlier Galaxy Glasses spec leak, showing where hands-free AI wearables are headed.

picks.headline: Move over Fitbit Air: Garmin's new CIRQA Smart Band is here
picks.excerpt: Garmin launched the CIRQA, its first screen-free smart band and a discreet Whoop/Fitbit Air rival, whose Active Intelligence AI insights and coaching sit behind the Connect+ subscription tier.
picks.rationale: Garmin's first screen-free band with AI 'Active Intelligence' coaching - a fresh hardware launch in the screenless wearable race, distinct from prior wearable coverage.
